title: What's New: Water and Waste Management (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Water and waste intensity types and enums
Setting up accounts, categories, and subcategories
Journal entries and posting water and waste data
Sustainability goals and targets for water and waste

features.name: Water management setup
features.description: New capability to track water metrics through sustainability accounts with options for water intensity or discharge into water, configurable through category and subcategory setup.

features.name: Water intensity factor
features.description: Similar to emission factors, allows custom formula configuration for water intensity tracking with configurable subcategories.

features.name: Discharge into water factor
features.description: New factor type for tracking water discharge with custom formula support alongside water intensity tracking.

features.name: Responsibility centers as facilities
features.description: Extended responsibility centers to function as facility designations for water and waste tracking with water capacity dimensions, enabling facility-level reporting.
caveats: Only needed for facility-based reporting requirements

features.name: Water capacity dimensions
features.description: New sustainability fast tab on responsibility centers for tracking water capacity with configurable capacity unit and quantity fields.
caveats: Requires standard unit of measure configuration

features.name: Waste management scope
features.description: New water and waste scope added alongside scope one, two, and three for emissions, enabling waste intensity tracking with optional factor configuration.

features.name: Waste intensity factor
features.description: Similar to water intensity, allows custom formulas for waste tracking with optional factor configuration in subcategories.
caveats: Custom formula required for factor usage

features.name: Water intensity type enum
features.description: Extensible enum for water posting with options: withdrawn, discharge, consume, recycled. Can be extended for custom intensity types.

features.name: Waste intensity type enum
features.description: Extensible enum for waste posting with options: generated, disposed, recovered. Can be extended for custom waste types.

features.name: Water type enum
features.description: Extensible enum for water source tracking with options: surface water, sea water, groundwater, third party water, produced water.
caveats: Only applies to water intensity type postings

features.name: Water and waste journal entries
features.description: Sustainability journal entries for water and waste with required intensity type selection and water type selection for water postings, currently limited to sustainability journal.
caveats: Water and waste intensity can only track through sustainability journal
Cannot be posted via general journal or purchase documents like emissions

features.name: Sustainability goals for water and waste
features.description: Water and waste intensity tracking in sustainability goals as targets and baselines, allowing forecast tracking against baseline from previous periods.
caveats: Same functionality as emissions goals and scorecards
